recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented output format shorthands (--json, --yaml, --raw) as global options.

Note: The --format <format> option cannot be global due to Commander.js limitations - when a parent command defines an option, it shadows child command options with the same name. The export command has its own --format option for different purposes (json, html), so global --format would conflict.

Implementation:
- Added setYamlMode(), isYamlMode(), isStructuredMode() to output.ts
- Added YAML output support using the yaml library's stringify()
- Updated output(), success(), error(), warn(), info() to support YAML format
- Added --json, --yaml, --raw as global shorthands in index.ts preAction hook
- Conflict detection for multiple format shorthands
- 13 tests covering: JSON/YAML output, shorthands equivalence, conflict errors, global scope

ACs covered:
- ac-format-json: --json produces valid JSON ✓
- ac-format-yaml: --yaml produces valid YAML ✓
- ac-json-shorthand: --json works globally ✓
- ac-raw-shorthand: --raw = --json ✓
- ac-yaml-shorthand: --yaml works globally ✓
- ac-conflict-error: Multiple format shorthands error ✓
- ac-yaml-no-ansi: YAML output has no ANSI codes ✓
- ac-yaml-references: @ prefix preserved in YAML ✓
- ac-global-scope: Works on item list, tasks ready, session start ✓
- ac-unsupported-format: Not applicable (--format not global)

recent_notes.task_title: Filter superseded notes from default task display
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented note supersession filtering:
- Added isNoteSuperseded(), filterSupersededNotes(), and annotateNotesWithSuperseded() helper functions in output.ts
- Updated formatTaskDetails() to filter superseded notes by default, show hidden count message
- Added --all flag to task get command to show full note history
- JSON output always includes all notes with 'superseded' computed field
- Updated session start to filter superseded notes from recent_notes
- 7 tests covering: hiding superseded notes, --all flag, JSON output, multiple supersessions, session start filtering

recent_notes.task_title: Add AC schema field validation to detect drift
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented AC schema drift detection with:
- checkACSchemaReferences() function that extracts field patterns from AC given/when/then clauses
- Validates against actual SpecItem and Task schema fields
- Detects conceptual fields like 'children' and 'parent' that exist at parse-time but aren't queryable
- Detects refs like 'spec_ref.field' where spec_ref is actually a string, not an object
- Added --drift flag to validate command
- File extension filtering to avoid false positives (spec.yaml, task.json, etc.)
- 8 tests covering: invalid fields, ref strings, valid fields, status fields, flag presence, exit codes, multiple drift issues

recent_notes.task_title: Cache scanTestCoverage() results for daemon performance
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented test coverage caching with:
- New coverage-cache.ts module with getCachedTestCoverage(), invalidateTestCoverageCache()
- TTL-based expiration (60 seconds default) for automatic cache refresh
- Per-project caching for multi-directory daemon support
- Parallel scan protection (prevents duplicate scans on concurrent requests)
- Updated daemon items route to use cached coverage
- 11 tests covering caching, TTL expiration, invalidation, and multi-project scenarios

recent_notes.task_title: Document fenced YAML requirement in plan import help and spec-plan skill
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content: Updated plan import --help text to include Format section explaining the fenced YAML code block requirement. Also updated spec-plan skill SKILL.md with an Important callout explaining that the Specs section MUST contain a fenced YAML code block. All 29 plan import tests pass.

recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implementation notes:

Register --format <format> as a global option alongside --json in index.ts.
Register --raw and --yaml as boolean shorthands that set format. In the
preAction hook, resolve shorthands to --format value, detect conflicts
(multiple shorthands or shorthand + --format), then call setJsonMode() or
a new setYamlMode(). Add yamlOutput() in output.ts using the yaml library
stringify(). Update output() to check yaml mode. Update @trait-json-output
ac-6 to reference the --format system instead of the old json takes
precedence behavior.

recently_completed.title: Document fenced YAML requirement in plan import help and spec-plan skill
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #360. Added fenced YAML requirement documentation to plan import --help text (new Format section) and spec-plan skill SKILL.md (Important callout). This improves discoverability of the required format for plan files.

recently_completed.title: Fix: plan import --update should update acceptance criteria on existing specs
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #359. Implemented actual update logic for plan import --update flag. Previously the code had a placeholder 'Update logic would go here - for now, skip' with no implementation. Now updateSpecItem() is called with description, type, traits, and acceptance_criteria from the plan. Added 2 new tests verifying AC updates and trait updates work correctly. Addresses ac-26 of @plan-import spec.

recently_completed.title: PR-review-merge fast-path for clean merges
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #358. Added fast-path section to pr-review skill that skips the full workflow when PR is clean (CI green, no comments, no threads, no changes requested). This is a skill-level guidance change directing subagent behavior - no code implementation needed.

recently_completed.title: Gate reflect phase on meaningful session work during ralph loop
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #357. Added gating logic to the reflect skill's Loop Mode section - agent now checks session introspection data (recently_completed tasks, working_tree status, recent_commits) before starting reflection. If no meaningful session work detected, reflection is skipped to prevent wasted time on empty reflection runs.

recently_completed.title: Fix: ralph noise stripping leaks on split-chunk boundaries
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #356. Implemented boundary-aware buffering in createTranslator to handle noise patterns split across streaming chunk boundaries. Added noiseBuffer to TranslatorState, processChunkWithBuffer() for partial pattern detection before stripping, and getPartialNoiseLength() for detecting incomplete patterns. 7 new tests cover split scenarios at various pattern boundaries and false-positive detection.

recently_completed.title: Distinguish graceful exit from abort in task-work-loop workflow
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #355. Added 'kspec workflow complete' command with --result option supporting success, no_work_available, and early_exit results. This allows distinguishing graceful loop termination (no_work_available) from actual failures (abort), making abort rate metrics meaningful. Added WorkflowRunResultSchema to schema and 14 tests covering all scenarios.

recently_completed.title: Implement Multi-Value Status Filter
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #354. --status filter on tasks list and item list now accepts comma-separated values (e.g. --status pending,in_progress). Invalid values show correct enum. Trailing/leading commas silently ignored. parseMultiStatus() utility handles both task and item status validation. 7 of 8 ACs covered by 10 tests. ac-repeated-flag gap noted: Commander.js option definition needs collect function for repeated flags -- can be addressed in follow-up.

inbox_items.text: Cross-feature requirement pattern: How to express that core features (search, validate, export) must support all entity types. When new entity type added, should automatically imply tasks for core features. Options: (1) applies_to field on feature specs, (2) trait on entity types like @trait-searchable, (3) validation warning for missing coverage, (4) parent spec that entity types must satisfy. Surfaced when realizing search doesn't cover inbox.

Reverse spec lookup - kspec which <file> or kspec which <file:line> to find specs/ACs that reference or are implemented by a given code path. Useful for bug fixes to quickly discover what specs need updating. Could scan for // AC: annotations and spec_ref links. Instructive, helps find already-instrumented code.

Add cross-platform CI matrix testing - run core functionality tests on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Would catch issues like Unix-specific commands (which, cp -r) before they reach PR review. Consider: matrix strategy in GitHub Actions, platform-specific test skips where needed, focus on CLI commands and daemon lifecycle.
E2E tests: Use isolated port range (not 3456) + cross-platform cleanup. Current approach conflicts with existing daemons. Should use high ephemeral port range and improve cleanup mechanism.
E2E test dev mode - configure Playwright to work with vite dev server instead of requiring full build for faster test iteration (12+ seconds to 1-2 seconds)

Improve derive granularity: Research suggests specs with 4+ ACs are candidates for splitting. Potential enhancements: (1) --by-ac flag to create tasks per AC group, (2) --max-acs N to auto-group, (3) implementation_phases field in specs, (4) derive templates for common patterns (cli-command, api-endpoint), (5) complexity warnings when specs are too large. See session research on task decomposition patterns from Linear, Atlassian, BDD/Example Mapping, and AI coding assistants.

Daemon debugging improvements: (1) Add --log-file or --verbose to 'kspec serve start', (2) Log resolved web UI path on startup, (3) Capture and show stderr when daemon fails to start within timeout. Consolidated from @01KFQ586, @01KFQ595, @01KFPH3D.

Project config file (kspec.config.yaml or .kspecrc): Configure shadow remote URL (enable separate repo for specs), feature toggles, default values (author, priority), validation strictness. Enables multi-repo projects sharing specs and tailoring kspec to project needs. Consolidated from @01KFGVVJ, @01KFGVVN.

AC test coverage analysis: 'kspec coverage @spec-ref' command to scan codebase for '// AC: @spec ac-N' annotations and report which ACs have test coverage vs gaps. Soft check for review, not blocking. Consolidated from @01KFHJNR, @01KFP9A6.

Shadow sync improvements: (1) Auto-resolve using rebase/merge-driver for cleaner sync, (2) Make sync warnings visible in CLI output (currently silent unless KSPEC_DEBUG=1), (3) Auto-detect common issues with suggested fixes. Consolidated from @01KFTDA7, @01KFHZR4.
